bibl.title: Amulet against fever.
bibl.seg: 141.13 P. Heid. Inv. Kopt. 407 = P. Heid. Kopt. 5

Anne Boud'hors, Alain Delattre, Gesa Schenke, Tonio Sebastian Richter & Georg Schmelz (edd.), Coptica Palatina. Koptische Texte aus der Heidelberger Papyrussammlung (P.Heid.Kopt.). Bearbeitet auf der Vierten Internationalen Sommerschule für Koptische Papyrologie Heidelberg, 26. August - 9. September 2012 = Studien und Texte aus der Heidelberger Papyrussammlung (STHP). 1 (Heidelberg, 2018) pp. 53-55, pl. X.
bibl.note: Provenance unknown, 11th-12th century. The other side contains fragments of three lines, the opening lines of an official letter in Arabic that was written earlier than the amulet, as the piece of paper was cut out of the letter.
